description: This file is a code-behind for the ASP.NET WebForms page 'TheoryExam.aspx'. It manages the server-side logic for loading theory questions, navigating pages, submitting answers, and handling an exam timer within an online examination system. The code interacts with a SQL Server database to retrieve questions, submit student answers, and manage exam and course queues.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: ASP.NET page code-behind class handling the logic for the theory exam interface, including question loading, submission, and timer management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load; loads questions from database, checks user session, and sets timer.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Converts course ID to course name.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the user profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Handles submission of student answers, updating answer tables, course queues, and marking the course as taken.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display and detects time out.
